name: thesis-resac-native-recipe-v8
interpretation: Restore the original PyTorch bus optimization recipe and channel definitions: shared actor/critic category embedding, learning rate 1e-5, batch 2048, ten critics (two for the archived SAC configuration), without-replacement replay samples and five settled transitions per update. Retain the frozen multi-line observations, normalization, same-vehicle feedback, physical actions and evaluation days; this is not the original single-corridor environment. All new methods and reused CS references have 100 training episodes. Archived 500-episode original-environment results remain separate. The recipe restoration is a bundle, not a single-factor learning-rate attribution.
